snippet.title: Shadow Cat - Available Now Trailer
snippet.description:
The shadows are waiting. Step into them now.

Shadow Cat is a dark 2D platformer where a cat boy fights to save a world swallowed by evil. Jump across deadly gaps, dash through dangerous terrain, and unleash fireballs against creatures lurking through forests, abandoned factories, caves, and tunnels.

Fight your way through 25 handcrafted levels packed with hazards, enemies, checkpoints, collectible life points, and fireball ammo. Every stage pushes your timing and movement further, leading to a final showdown against a giant spider boss and its minions.

Get hit and you’ll lose a life and return to the latest checkpoint. Lose every life and the level starts again. Learn the route, sharpen your reflexes, and keep moving through the darkness.

Shadow Cat is available now on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Windows PC.

Get Shadow Cat on the Microsoft Store:

Shadow Cat (Windows):
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/shadow-cat-windows/9mzj7zjg1ppx

Shadow Cat (Xbox One):
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/shadow-cat-xbox-one/9mz2r9pd8l6w

Shadow Cat (Xbox Series):
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/shadow-cat-xbox-series/9nlcszbxzwx5

Developed and published by Avgam.

Rated E10+ for Everyone 10+. Visit www.esrb.org for rating information.
